newsitem.title: USA: PMC Intl closes private placement.
newsitem.headline: PMC Intl closes private placement.

text.p: PMC International Inc said on Thursday that it has closed a private placement of stock and restructured its indebtedness and preferred shares to increase the number of shares outstanding to 14.4 million from 5.5 million.
PMC said 5,177,000 shares of common stock were sold at a price of $2.125 per share, yielding approximately $11 million gross proceeds before offering expenses, the company said.
The company has agreed to file a registration statement covering resale of the shares included in the private placement within the next 45 days, PMC said.
Also, PMC said holders of approximately $4.5 million of the company's indebtedness restructured their interests in the company.
Holders of $1.5 million of indebtedness exercised warrants to purchase 1.5 million shares of common stock in exchange for their indebtedness, the company said.
Bedford Capital Financial Corp was repaid approximately $2 million of its indebtedness and Beford exercised warrants to buy 1 million shares in exchange for $1 million of debt.
PMC International said Beford was also issued approximately 1 million shares of common stock in exchange for the cancellation of certain warrants it held.

In addition, several holders of the company's preferred stock exchanged their shares of preferred stock for common stock at a rate of 1.375 shares of common stock for each share of preferred stock, PMC said.
Approximately 211,000 of the 349,000 shares of preferred stock outstanding were so exchanged.
Shares held by Bedford and those issued debt restructuring are also to be included in the registration statement.
PMC International's board will be increased to seven from five in connection with the private placement, PMC said.
